payload.entry: Archive-column contracts for later phases. List keys: run = user.machine@run (index agent_id), container:<container_key>, banner:<banner_key>, tail:<banner_key>; ArchiveViewState.selected_key now holds the highlighted item of ANY kind (is_archive_row_key tells runs/containers from banners/tails); new state fields folded_banners (explicit fold overrides; expanded_banners holds explicit opens) and reveal_row (exact-arrival row, walked into view by opening its banner, paging, then expanding its container). get_agents_tab_selection: row_kind agent|container|none (banner, tail, loading, focused pulse => none) plus light_row; archive_read_only_context is None for non-run items. Key routing: route_archive_key(owner, INTENT_*) in _archive_view is called first by action_next_patch/prev_patch (j k), scroll_to_top/bottom (g G), expand_or_layout/hooks_or_collapse (l h), focus_next/prev_agent_panel (J K, one switch), act_on_agent (Enter); Archive navigation clamps (no wrap). Column code lives in _archive_column.py (state/plan/paint/chrome; public column_archive/column_runtime/column_widget/refresh_column/schedule_detail/sync_archive_chrome/archive_light_row/archive_container_members) and _archive_column_nav.py; widgets in widgets/agents_archive/. Detail seam for 3.1.5: _paint_detail_placeholder in _archive_column.py (debounced through schedule_detail with the DetailOwnership token); it currently just calls AgentDetail.show_empty(). Query/grouping changes (3.1.4) must call request_archive_view_load after changing ArchiveViewState; the column plans windows from the held summary only when snapshot.applied_query/grouping match committed_query/grouping. open/close_agents_archive_view now call sync_archive_chrome (lazy mount, #agents-content.-archive-active toggles #agent-list-container vs #archive-column; Inbox widgets stay mounted). Pulse: attention = Inbox header asking(stopped) count via _agent_info_metrics; updated live through refresh_archive_inbox_pulse without touching the list or detail debounce.
